lane_impact: L1 world-exploration and L6 art-anim: CORRECTS the world-exploration journal's own lane_impact on claim ap-regen-and-cap, which reads this line as "a death/retreat condition". It is an idle-pose selector. grep for `STAT_AP) == 0` across all 559 android classes returns this single line — there is no AP-death rule anywhere. The portable rule is: adventure-mode idle has two poses (tired / idle_sheathed) gated on AP==0, and duel-mode idle has two poses gated on HP <= 25%. That is a real L6 animation-state finding the ledger does not carry.
text: AP==0 in adventure mode does not kill or retreat the player — it swaps the idle animation to "tired"; outside adventure mode the same pose fires at HP <= maxhp/4.

lane_impact: L1 world-exploration: completes the name generator. Of the 36 sectors in a territory, the 4x4 interior block (x and y both in 2..3) gets no prefix, the edge sectors get one letter and the 16 corner sectors get two. frame_0020 (sector 1,3 -> 'W') and frame_0080 (sector 3,2 -> none) are both consistent, and the full name is dir + territoryName + ' ' + bgString where bgString is a switch over 8 background families (strings 1002/1003/1006/1015/1020/1021/1022).
text: The generated node-name prefix is two-axis, not one: dir1 comes from the sector Y (<=1 -> string 398 'N', >=4 -> 399 'S') and dir2 from the sector X (<=1 -> 401 'W', >=4 -> 400 'E'), concatenated - so corner sectors emit 'NW', 'SE' and so on.

lane_impact: L1 world-exploration: a latent bug in the original world generator, not a design choice. Because rnd() returns [0,1), rand(3) is confined to {0,1,2}. A faithful 1:1 port must decide explicitly whether to reproduce the bug (always 1 exit) or the evident intent (sometimes 2) - and must say which. Worth checking the sibling getSouth/East/WestExits for the same pattern.
text: TerritoryData.getNorthExits contains a dead branch: rng.rand(3) can only return 0, 1 or 2, but the code tests dice == 3 to set count = 2 - so every territory generates exactly one north exit.

cite: reference/decompiled/shs3_android/scripts/InteractUI_crops.as:607, with the stat's identity fixed at :104-107
lane_impact: L1 world-exploration: corrects world-exploration/farming-tables. startingIndex+2 is the cumulative harvest counter (capped 50), which getPatchLevel(:457) maps to soil grade 1-6 at 10/20/30/40/50 -- Obj_VegePatch.as:78 mislabels the same stat 'soilLevel', which is probably what misled the survey. The guard is `== 1` exactly, not `== 0` and not `<= 1`, so a brand-new patch's first harvest rolls the normal 1/(10-farmSkill) dice (10% at skill 0) and only the next one is free. Oddly specific -- flag it as either an authored quirk or an original-code off-by-one when it lands in config/farming.ts, and label it v0.682.
text: The farming guaranteed-yield rule is 'harvestedTimes == 1', i.e. the SECOND harvest, not the first -- the survey's 'first harvest guaranteed' would be ported wrong.
